info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Collections Management API
info.description: The Card Collections Management API allows businesses to update and manage their card collection records efficiently. Utilizing this API, users can modify existing collection details, such as payment statuses or customer information, ensuring accuracy in their financial operations. This functionality is especially beneficial for financial institutions and collection agencies aiming to streamline their card processing workflows. With seamless integration, developers can enhance their applications to provide real-time updates on card collections, improving overall service delivery.

patch.description: Updates the status of the specified card collection identified by CARD-400045. This operation allows for modifying various attributes of the card collection to reflect its current state in the operational services.

requestBody.description: This request body allows you to modify the attributes of a specific card collection identified by CARD-400045. You can update various properties related to the card collection through this patch operation.
